name: autheo_marketplace_list_listings
description: Browse purchasable Marketplace listings; preserves exact THEO strings and upstream page metadata.
access: Configured Marketplace application URL. Public listing/capacity reads do not require a Clerk session.

name: autheo_devhub_list_deployments
description: Read deployments visible to the configured DevHub team.
access: Configured DevHub URL and Hive identity; scoped to the configured team.

name: autheo_get_latest_block
description: Get the latest Autheo blockchain block.
access: Configured CometBFT RPC or Cosmos REST endpoint. Network status also checks DevHub health.

name: autheo_marketplace_estimate_listing
description: Local exact-decimal estimate from current listing price; NOT an authoritative checkout quote/reservation.
access: Configured Marketplace application URL. Public listing/capacity reads do not require a Clerk session.

name: autheo_devhub_get_build_logs
description: Read the last 1–2000 build log lines; never executes a build.
access: Configured DevHub URL and Hive identity; scoped to the configured team.

name: autheo_get_integration_guide
description: Local integration map and prerequisites; does not claim a live backend connection.
access: Local metadata only. No service endpoint or credentials required.

name: autheo_get_server_info
description: Return information about the Autheo MCP server. This is a local MCP capability check and does not query the blockchain.
access: Local metadata only. No service endpoint or credentials required.

name: autheo_get_network_status
description: Get the current status of the Autheo network. Queries the configured CometBFT RPC endpoint and DevHub health endpoint.
access: Configured CometBFT RPC or Cosmos REST endpoint. Network status also checks DevHub health.

name: autheo_get_block
description: Retrieve an Autheo block by height.
access: Configured CometBFT RPC or Cosmos REST endpoint. Network status also checks DevHub health.

name: autheo_get_transaction
description: Retrieve an Autheo transaction by transaction hash.
access: Configured CometBFT RPC or Cosmos REST endpoint. Network status also checks DevHub health.

name: autheo_get_account
description: Retrieve basic information about an Autheo account.
access: Configured CometBFT RPC or Cosmos REST endpoint. Network status also checks DevHub health.

name: autheo_get_balance
description: Retrieve the native THEO balance for an Autheo address.
access: Configured CometBFT RPC or Cosmos REST endpoint. Network status also checks DevHub health.

name: autheo_get_theo_price
description: Return display-only THEO/USD data with freshness status; not settlement authority. This tool is intentionally separated from marketplace pricing. Marketplace prices should be denominated in THEO while this oracle provides the external USD reference value.
access: Price conversions require a fresh configured Marketplace or explicit price feed. Unavailable prices are not fabricated.

name: autheo_convert_theo_to_usd
description: Convert THEO to a display-only USD estimate using a fresh configured price feed. No trade is executed.
access: Price conversions require a fresh configured Marketplace or explicit price feed. Unavailable prices are not fabricated.

name: autheo_convert_usd_to_theo
description: Convert a USD amount to a display-only THEO estimate using a fresh configured price feed. No trade is executed.
access: Price conversions require a fresh configured Marketplace or explicit price feed. Unavailable prices are not fabricated.

name: autheo_marketplace_categories
description: Return the major Autheo marketplace resource categories.
access: Local metadata only. No service endpoint or credentials required.

name: autheo_compute_search
description: Search reported DevHub hardware, NOT reservable marketplace listings. Use autheo_marketplace_list_listings for purchasable inventory. Prices are expressed in THEO. USD conversion should be performed separately through the Autheo oracle.
access: Configured DevHub URL and Hive identity; scoped to the configured team.

name: autheo_storage_search
description: Search reported DevHub storage hardware, NOT reservable marketplace listings.
access: Configured DevHub URL and Hive identity; scoped to the configured team.

name: autheo_get_provider
description: Inspect a DevHub node by ID. This is not a Marketplace provider identity.
access: Configured DevHub URL and Hive identity; scoped to the configured team.

name: autheo_get_provider_reputation
description: Inspect DevHub node capacity metadata. Not a verified commercial reputation score.
access: Configured DevHub URL and Hive identity; scoped to the configured team.

name: autheo_get_order
description: Retrieve an Autheo marketplace order. Reads the authenticated Marketplace order. A marketplace order is not a DevHub deployment.
access: Configured Marketplace URL and a valid Clerk session. Upstream enforces buyer/provider role and tenant.

name: autheo_compute_quote
description: Return a legacy compute simulation with unavailable pricing. No purchasable quote is available; use listing estimates instead.
access: Legacy simulation only; returns unavailable pricing, never an authoritative checkout quote.

name: autheo_storage_quote
description: Return a legacy storage simulation with unavailable pricing. No storage contract is created; use listing estimates instead.
access: Legacy simulation only; returns unavailable pricing, never an authoritative checkout quote.

name: autheo_devhub_search
description: Search deployment-backed DevHub projects and deployments (not a complete project inventory).
access: Configured DevHub URL and Hive identity; scoped to the configured team.

name: autheo_devhub_get_project
description: Inspect settings for a deployment-backed DevHub project, not a complete inventory of all projects.
access: Configured DevHub URL and Hive identity; scoped to the configured team.

name: autheo_devhub_get_job
description: Inspect a DevHub build by its ID. This does not schedule a job.
access: Configured DevHub URL and Hive identity; scoped to the configured team.

name: autheo_marketplace_get_listing
description: Get live listing detail, constraints and canonical decimal-string price.
access: Configured Marketplace application URL. Public listing/capacity reads do not require a Clerk session.

name: autheo_marketplace_get_capacity
description: Read public capacity projection; does not expose the private mesh advertisement API.
access: Configured Marketplace application URL. Public listing/capacity reads do not require a Clerk session.

name: autheo_marketplace_list_orders
description: List orders for the configured Clerk session's buyer tenant (upstream limit 100).
access: Configured Marketplace URL and a valid Clerk session. Upstream enforces buyer/provider role and tenant.

name: autheo_marketplace_get_placement_policy
description: Read an order's placement constraints; never schedule or mutate the policy.
access: Configured Marketplace URL and a valid Clerk session. Upstream enforces buyer/provider role and tenant.

name: autheo_marketplace_get_settlement_status
description: Read recorded settlement status. Does NOT verify payments or trigger allocation.
access: Configured Marketplace URL and a valid Clerk session. Upstream enforces buyer/provider role and tenant.

name: autheo_marketplace_provider_view
description: Read own provider profile, listings, node_bindings, orders, or infrastructure_rewards; Clerk role/tenant enforced upstream.
access: Configured Marketplace URL and a valid Clerk session. Upstream enforces buyer/provider role and tenant.

name: autheo_marketplace_list_l0_deployments
description: Private HMAC/mTLS service read of short-lived L0 advertisements. Not public listing inventory.
access: Private bridge URL and HMAC credentials; optional private CA and mTLS client certificates. Not public inventory.

name: autheo_devhub_list_nodes
description: Read and normalize DevHub nodes; hardware totals do not imply available marketplace capacity.
access: Configured DevHub URL and Hive identity; scoped to the configured team.

name: autheo_devhub_get_deployment
description: Find a deployment in the team-scoped /deployments response.
access: Configured DevHub URL and Hive identity; scoped to the configured team.

name: autheo_devhub_list_projects
description: List project names derived from visible deployments; undeployed projects are not included.
access: Configured DevHub URL and Hive identity; scoped to the configured team.

name: autheo_devhub_get_build
description: Read DevHub build state and evidence from the real /v1/builds/{id} route.
access: Configured DevHub URL and Hive identity; scoped to the configured team.

name: autheo_devhub_get_deployment_resources
description: Read actual deployment resources from DevHub.
access: Configured DevHub URL and Hive identity; scoped to the configured team.

name: autheo_devhub_status
description: Read overview, cluster, mesh, security, or wallet metadata; process liveness is not mesh health.
access: Configured DevHub URL and Hive identity; scoped to the configured team.
